bullets_en: IMD Hyderabad has issued an orange alert, forecasting very heavy monsoon rains on Sunday.
Heavy rain very likely in isolated parts of Adilabad, Kumuram Bheem Asifabad, Mancherial, Peddapalli.
Thunderstorms with lightning and gusty winds likely in many districts, including Hyderabad.
Hyderabad city: light to moderate rain or thundershowers likely under a cloudy sky.
bullets_ur: IMD Hyderabad ne Sunday ko tez monsoon barishon ki peshgoi ke sath orange alert jaari kiya.
Adilabad, Kumuram Bheem Asifabad, Mancherial aur Peddapalli mein isolated tez barish ka imkaan.
Hyderabad samait kayi districts mein garaj, bijli aur tez hawaon ke sath toofan ka imkaan.
Shehar mein halki se darmiyani barish ya thundershowers; aasman par badal chhaye rahenge.
